items.name: NO. 88
items.description: A green-black tea, where flavors and aromas intertwine like the endless loop of an infinity curve (∞). Taste made for everyday enjoyment, as refreshing yuzu, cooling mint, and sweet honeybush blend in gentle, seamless harmony.

items.name: THE MAFIA
items.description: A black tea inspired by an image of a mafia man biting into caramel and exhaling a curl of smoke. Sharp edge of cinnamon cuts through the sweetness of caramel, weaving a compelling contrast between rugged intensity and smooth softness.

items.name: LEATHER BOOTS
items.description: A black tea layered with comforting scents of roasted peanuts and almonds, followed by quiet hints of whiskey. Aftertaste of warmth and depth, like the soft embrace of aged leather.

items.name: ROOI
items.description:
A rooibos tea that spreads freely like a black horse running through a red desert. Harmonious finish of subtly sweet notes and a smoky oak aftertaste, offering depth and clarity.
Caffeine-Free

items.name: MANTIS
items.description:
A mint tea softly and steadily infusing like a mantis easing across damp grass. Fresh bite of peppermint and smooth essence of spearmint gradually unveil a gentle, airy sweetness.
Caffeine-Free

items.name: BLACK CARAMEL
items.description: A black tea with the scorched sweetness and toasty nuttiness of burnt caramel. Gentle aftertaste, where the mellow richness of caramel meets bright, bitter edges of bergamot.

items.name: BLUE MONK
items.description: A pu'er tea reminiscent of a monk in a blue robe, evoking a serene and refined mood. Citrus notes of bergamot blend with mellow coconut and refreshing spearmint, conjuring the atmosphere of a forest at dawn.

items.name: CHATEAU NOIR
items.description: Deep, smoky nuance like oak, infused with scents of black currant, caramel, and vanilla. Rich body of red fruit spreads on the first sip, leaving a long aftertaste and a heavy, woody finish.

items.name: CHAMO PILLOW
items.description:
A chamomile tea, embodying the coziness of resting your face on a soft, fluffy pillow. Warm sweetness, reminiscent of an afternoon bathed in sunlight, flowing into leisurely softness.
Caffeine-Free

items.name: PEACH ROSIE
items.description: A white tea reminiscent of the quiet moment a girl with peach-tinted cheeks breathes in the scent of a rose. Clean, gentle finish where the soft sweetness of peach mingles with delicate hints of apricot and rose.

items.name: WHITE SUNSET
items.description: A black tea infused with bitter sweetness of vanilla and jasmine, delicately layered with the aftertaste of bergamot. Soft, refined touch, where powdery textures drift gently across each layer.
